name: [UPD] Divaz 💄
desc:
Welcome to Divaz!
The baddest city where you can slay divas, get clout, make money and run the streets!

How to Play:
💸 Earn money by grinding jobs or taking risks
💅 Slay anyone who tries you
✨ Get clout and become the ultimate baddie
👗 Create your outfit in our avatar catalog
💃 Dance and have fun with friends

💜 Make sure to join the group and give your feedback. It helps a lot!

Thanks for playing!
